label: Budget vs. Actual Variance Analyzer
description: Analyzes budget vs. actual variances across cost centers and accounts. Identifies material variances, classifies as price/volume/mix effects, and produces management commentary.

claudeKnowledge.description: Management accounting variance analysis, price-volume-mix decomposition, management commentary standards

guidedInputs.label: Budget vs. actual data
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your budget vs. actual table. Include account/cost center, budget, actual, and variance columns.

e.g.
Revenue — Budget: 12 500 000, Actual: 11 800 000, Variance: -700 000 (-5.6%)
Staff costs — Budget: 4 200 000, Actual: 4 450 000, Variance: -250 000 (-6.0%)
IT costs — Budget: 380 000, Actual: 290 000, Variance: +90 000 (+23.7%)
...

guidedInputs.label: Materiality threshold
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Variances above 100 000 SEK or 5% of budget line — whichever is lower

guidedInputs.label: Business context and known drivers
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe known reasons for significant variances and relevant business events in the period.
e.g. Revenue below budget due to Nordea project delayed by 3 weeks. Staff costs above budget due to unplanned recruitment. IT savings from postponed infrastructure upgrade.

guidedInputs.label: Prior period actuals (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Prior period actuals for year-over-year comparison.
